scientific.integrity: The primary full text was inspected at the model assumptions, Theorem 7, the definitions of the auxiliary upper bounds, the numerical example, and the discussion of the theorem conditions. A related earlier discrete fear-effect model was compared for broader global-stability coverage. The bundled symbolic checker independently verifies the algebraic identity used in the contradiction. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result proves only that the printed sufficient conditions in Theorem 7 are mutually inconsistent. It does not determine the actual global-attractivity region and does not infer a corrected inequality.

title: The positive-equilibrium global-attractivity criterion is vacuous
